enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Eyes closed. Breathing slowly. Occasionally turn over. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and taking a shower
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Remove clothes. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step in. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse. Turn off shower. Dry with towel. Wash face. Dry face.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out breakfast items. Close refrigerator. Prepare eggs and toast. Cook eggs. Toast bread. Pour milk. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Clear table.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing into work clothes and gathering work belongings
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Take out work clothes. Close closet. Put on clothes. Put on shoes. Take out ID badge. Put on badge. Pick up stethoscope. Put in bag. Pick up keys and phone. Pick up bag. Walk to door.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the work shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look at phone. Get off bus. Walk to hospital entrance. Open door. Walk in.

enriched_activities.activity: Working a clinical shift as a health care professional, caring for patients
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to patient room. Knock. Enter. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Listen to heart and lungs. Record data on chart. Administer medication. Adjust IV drip. Talk to patient about symptoms. Walk to nurses station. Use computer to update records. Attend team meeting. Discuss patient cases. Walk to supply room. Restock gloves and syringes. Walk to another patient room. Assist with wound dressing. Wash hands. Walk to break room. Eat lunch. Walk back to floor. Continue patient rounds.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look at phone. Get off bus. Walk to home. Open door. Enter home.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Prepare ingredients. Cook dinner. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Clear table.

enriched_activities.activity: Cleaning up the kitchen and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Clear table. Scrape food into trash. Rinse plates. Open dishwasher. Load plates. Load utensils. Load pots. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Wipe counter with sponge. Wipe stove. Sweep floor. Take out trash.

Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Browse phone. Put down phone. Watch TV. Stand up. Go to kitchen. Get snack. Return to couch. Sit down. Continue watching TV. Turn off TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking an evening shower and washing up
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Take off clothes. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step in. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse. Turn off shower. Dry with towel. Brush teeth. Wash face. Put on pajamas.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV in bed and reading before sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on TV. Get into bed. Sit up. Watch TV. Pick up book. Open book. Read. Turn page. Read. Close book. Put down book. Pick up remote. Turn off TV. Turn off light. Lie down.
Lie in bed. Eyes closed. Breathing slowly. Occasionally turn over. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket.
